params.name: namesArray
params.description: Names of picture Codecs, parallel/synchronized to codecArray.
If passed, also return codecs that can only decode (read) pictures.

overloads.semanticRole: The PICTURE CODEC LIST command fills the codecArray array with the list of picture Codec IDs that are available on the machine where it is executed.

discriminatedBy.rule: By default (no '*'), only encoding-capable (write) codecs are returned; passing '*' additionally includes read-only (decoding) codecs in the result.

constraints: Codec IDs returned can be a file extension (e.g. ".gif"), a Mime type (e.g. "image/jpeg"), or, if QuickTime is enabled, a 4-character QuickTime code; the exact form depends on how the codec is registered at the OS level.
Codec IDs returned by this command are valid values for the format/codec parameter of WRITE PICTURE FILE and PICTURE TO BLOB.
